combo7.title: Deep-Eyes + Dictator of D.: Ultimate Spirit on Turn One
combo7.description: Going first from two cards: Deep-Eyes White Dragon, the Blue Abyss and Dictator of D. Deep-Eyes discards itself for Sage with Eyes of Blue. Dictator's cost sends Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck to the GY, and because Deep-Eyes was already there, it comes back with that dragon's 3000 ATK. Sage adds Maiden of White, Dictator becomes Spirit with Eyes of Blue for Mausoleum of White, and Mausoleum's extra Normal Summon puts Maiden next to Sage. Deep-Eyes counts as a "Blue-Eyes" monster, so its Level 10 and the two Level 1 Tuners make Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon. Spirit then revives Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Maiden follows it out of the GY, and the pair become Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon. End board: Ultimate Spirit Dragon, which negates a card or effect activated on the field, and Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon, which negates a GY effect and stops either player from summoning 2 or more monsters at once, on Mausoleum of White. Ash Blossom can hit any of the three searches: Deep-Eyes's, Sage's or Spirit's. Dictator's summon is safe from it, because sending Blue-Eyes White Dragon is a cost.

combo8.title: Going Second: Sage + Deep-Eyes Call White Phantom Beast
combo8.description: Going second into a board of monsters, from Sage with Eyes of Blue and Deep-Eyes White Dragon, the Blue Abyss. Sage's Normal Summon adds Maiden of White, and Deep-Eyes discards itself for a second Sage. That Sage discards itself to send the first one to the GY and Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon, the White Phantom Beast from the Deck. It came from the Deck, so it destroys every monster your opponent controls. Maiden places True Light, True Light Sets Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons, and Roar calls Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck, which brings Maiden back. Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Maiden become Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon, and the dragon going to the GY as material brings Deep-Eyes back with 3000 ATK. After the wipe only "Blue-Eyes" monsters can attack directly, and all three are: White Phantom Beast (3000), Deep-Eyes (3000) and Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon (2500) make 8500, if your opponent has nothing else to stop the attacks. You need a second Sage with Eyes of Blue in the Deck. Ash Blossom can stop either search, Sage's summon from the Deck or Roar's; Maiden placing True Light and True Light Setting Roar are out of its reach.

combo9.title: Sage + The Guiding Flute: Deep-Eyes from the Deck
combo9.description: Going first from Sage with Eyes of Blue and The Guiding Flute of Summoning Dragons. Sage is a Spellcaster, so once it's on the field the Flute can Special Summon a Level 5 or higher Dragon from the Deck. Going first that's Deep-Eyes White Dragon, the Blue Abyss, a Level 10 body for Ultimate Spirit Dragon: White Phantom Beast's wipe would have nothing to hit yet. Maiden of White, from Sage's search, places True Light, True Light Sets Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons, and Roar's Blue-Eyes White Dragon brings Maiden back. Deep-Eyes, Sage and Maiden then make Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon. Both the Flute and Roar lock you into Dragons (the Flute allows Spellcasters too) for the turn, and everything in the line fits. End board: Ultimate Spirit Dragon and Blue-Eyes White Dragon, with True Light stopping your opponent from targeting the dragon. The Flute's draw needs a Main Phase 2, and the first turn of the Duel has none, so it only works when you go second or later. Ash Blossom on the Flute stops the line, and on Sage's search or on Roar it leaves you a Tuner short of Ultimate Spirit Dragon.

combo10.title: Going Second: Sage + The Guiding Flute Call Two White Phantom Beasts
combo10.description: Going second into 2 or more monsters, from Sage with Eyes of Blue and The Guiding Flute of Summoning Dragons. Sage's Normal Summon adds Maiden of White, and Sage is the Spellcaster the Flute needs. The Flute Special Summons Blue-Eyes White Dragon, the White Phantom Beast from the Deck, and because your opponent controls 2 or more monsters it calls a second copy too. Both came from the Deck, but the wipe is once per turn, so only one of them destroys your opponent's monsters. Maiden places True Light, True Light Sets Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons, and Roar's Blue-Eyes White Dragon brings Maiden back. Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Maiden become Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon. After the wipe only "Blue-Eyes" monsters can attack directly: the two White Phantom Beasts (3000 each) and Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon (2500) make 8500, if your opponent has nothing else to stop the attacks. Sage can't attack directly. You need two White Phantom Beasts in the Deck. The Flute only allows Dragon and Spellcaster summons for the rest of the turn, and everything in the line fits. In Main Phase 2 the Flute can banish itself from the GY to draw 1 card. Ash Blossom on the Flute stops the line; on Sage's search or Roar it costs you Spirit Dragon's 2500.
